title: UltraLottery
description: 🎰 UltraLottery transforms your server’s lottery into a unique experience. Buy tickets, win jackpots, and enjoy the excitement of automatic draws with great rewards.
body:
# 🎰 UltraLottery

### The ultimate lottery experience for your server

UltraLottery is not just a lottery plugin.
It is a new way to create excitement, competition, and unforgettable moments inside your server.

Built with dedication, optimized for performance, and designed with player experience in mind, UltraLottery provides a complete jackpot system, ticket purchases, and automatic draws to make every game much more exciting.

Every ticket matters.
Every second counts.
Only one player will claim the glory.

---

## ✨ What makes UltraLottery special?

🎟 **Complete ticket purchase system**
Allows players to easily join the lottery.

💰 **Dynamic jackpot**
The prize grows as more players participate.

⏳ **Automatic draws**
Set how often the lottery runs.

📢 **Automatic global announcements**
The whole server will know who won.

🛠 **Fully configurable**
Messages, rewards, prices, timers, and more.

🖥 **User-friendly GUI**
Simple and easy to use for everyone.

🔌 **Economy integration (Vault)**
Compatible with most economy plugins.

📊 **PlaceholderAPI support**
Perfect for scoreboards, holograms, and menus.

⚡ **Lightweight and optimized**
Designed to use very few resources.

🔒 **Permission system**
Full control for administrators.

---

## ⚙ Commands

`/lottery`

Main system command.

---

## 🔑 Permissions

`lottery.use` → Allows players to participate.
`lottery.admin` → Allows plugin administration.

---

## 📦 Dependencies

### Required:

• Vault

Compatible with:

• EssentialsX Economy
• CMI Economy
• EconomyShopGUI
• Any Vault-supported economy plugin

---

### Optional:

• PlaceholderAPI

Available placeholders:

`%lottery_jackpot%`
`%lottery_tickets%`
`%lottery_time_left%`

---

## 🖥 Compatibility

✔ Paper
✔ Spigot

---

## 🎮 Supported versions

✔ 1.13+ up to 1.21+

---

## 🚀 Installation

1. Install Vault
2. (Optional) Install PlaceholderAPI
3. Place UltraLottery into `/plugins`
4. Restart the server
5. Configure the plugin
6. Enjoy the experience

---

## ❤️ Made with passion

UltraLottery was created with dedication to provide a fun, stable, and exciting experience for servers of any size.

Each update aims to improve performance, add new features, and offer a better experience for the community.

Thank you for trusting and supporting this project.
